question: Will Hyperliquid (HYPE) reach $100 at any point in November 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the HYPE/USD price on CoinGecko reaches $100.00 or above at any point during November 2026 (UTC).
- "No": Wins if the HYPE/USD price on CoinGecko does not reach $100.00 at any point during November 2026 (UTC).

Clarifications:
- "Reaches $100" means the HYPE/USD spot price (as recorded on CoinGecko's daily high or real-time price feed) touches or exceeds $100.00 on any UTC calendar day within November 2026 (00:00 UTC November 1 through 23:59 UTC November 30, 2026).
